hunks.baseline: I stared at the middle-aged man in front of me.
hunks.sol: I stared at the middle-aged man before me.

hunks.baseline: A tycoon with a business empire and a fortune worth trillions of won, he had followed his father, a former U.S. president, to make history as the third father-and-son presidential pair in United States history.
hunks.sol: A tycoon with a business empire and a fortune worth trillions of won, he had followed his father, a former U.S. president, into office. They were the third father-and-son pair to hold the presidency in United States history.

hunks.baseline: With his neat appearance, almost like an English gentleman, he looked twenty years younger than his actual age, and his smile toward us held genuine warmth.
hunks.sol: Neat as a British gentleman, he looked twenty years younger than he was. His smile as he greeted us was genuine.

hunks.baseline: Unlike his father, President Doramp wore his hair neatly combed back as we shook his hand.
hunks.sol: Unlike his father, President Doramp wore his hair neatly combed back. We shook his hand.

hunks.baseline: I never thought I would meet the President of the United States in person after seeing him only on television and in online articles. Even seeing him in person, I still couldn't help but marvel.
hunks.sol: I’d seen the President of the United States on television and in online articles, but I’d never imagined meeting him. Even with him standing right in front of me, I could hardly believe it.

hunks.baseline: “Haha, there’s no need to look at me like that. If anything, I’m the one who finds this amazing. I’m finally meeting the two of you after hearing so much about you.”
hunks.sol: “Haha, there’s no need to look at me like that. If anything, I’m the one who’s amazed. After hearing so much about you both, I finally get to meet you.”

hunks.baseline: “I know that a joint national funeral was held in South Korea. I mourn the victims whose lives were tragically taken by such injustice, and I pray that Mr. Kim, the former Guild Master of the Peace Guild, may rest in peace.”
hunks.sol: “I know a joint national funeral was held in Korea. My condolences to the victims who lost their lives so tragically, and to Mr. Kim, the former Guild Master of the Peace Guild. May they rest in peace.”

hunks.baseline: President Doramp was a gentleman not only in appearance, but in his manner as well.
hunks.sol: President Doramp was a gentleman in manner as well as appearance.

hunks.baseline: Even though he had already done the proper thing by sending the U.S. ambassador to South Korea and the Secretary of State to attend the joint national funeral, the fact that he had not forgotten to offer his condolences personally proved it.
hunks.sol: He had already done the proper thing by sending the U.S. ambassador to Korea and the Secretary of State to the funeral. Yet he had remembered to offer his condolences in person, too.

hunks.sol: “Everyone, this is Mr. Choi, who leads the Peace Guild and Ares Guild. And this is Mr. Jin, whom you all know. As for the people here…”

hunks.sol: Names and titles I’d heard in Hollywood war movies flew past me.

hunks.sol: *How many departments and titles are there?*

hunks.sol: President Doramp snapped his fingers, and the hologram that had vanished when we arrived filled the room again.

hunks.baseline: A map. Not a map of the entire Earth, but one depicting a specific region in precise detail.
hunks.sol: A map. Not of the whole Earth, but a detailed map of one region.

hunks.baseline: Coordinates were written over countless buildings and various landforms, while markers of unknown significance glittered here and there like stars.
hunks.sol: Coordinates hovered over countless buildings and stretches of terrain. Markers whose meaning I couldn’t guess glittered here and there like stars.

hunks.baseline: The place names written on the holographic map. The terrain scattered with deserts.
And the words President Doramp had spoken when we first arrived.
hunks.sol: The place names. The deserts scattered across the map. And what President Doramp had been saying when we arrived.

hunks.baseline: I realized what it was and muttered,
“The Middle East?”

hunks.baseline: “It’s a tactical map showing the locations of the terrorist groups. The sparkling markers are probably Gates or their bases.”

hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi had spoken almost at the same time as me. President Doramp nodded to us both.

hunks.baseline: “Both answers are correct. However, Mr. Choi’s answer was much more detailed and closer to the truth. Those lights mark locations believed to be terrorist-group headquarters. Hologram, zoom out.”
hunks.sol: “You’re both right, though Mr. Choi’s answer is more detailed and closer to the mark. The lights indicate suspected terrorist bases. Hologram, zoom out.”

hunks.baseline: The enlarged hologram shrank into the shape of a globe.
As the globe slowly rotated at President Doramp’s gesture, large and small lights glimmered across its surface.
hunks.sol: The enlarged map shrank into a globe. It turned slowly at President Doramp’s gesture, lights large and small scattered across its surface.

hunks.baseline: “When my late father was president, there were already more than a hundred Islamic terrorist organizations. Of course, after the Great Cataclysm, they multiplied at a frightening rate.”
hunks.sol: “When my late father was president, there were already more than a hundred Islamic terrorist organizations alone. After the Great Cataclysm, of course, they multiplied at a frightening rate.”

hunks.baseline: That was the first I had heard of it.
hunks.sol: That was news to me.

hunks.baseline: More than a hundred Islamic terrorist organizations alone—and that had been before the Great Cataclysm. There was no telling how many there were now.
hunks.sol: More than a hundred Islamic terrorist organizations *before* the Great Cataclysm. Who knew how many there were now?

hunks.baseline: Of course, some of them were probably small terrorist groups that operated on the level of clubs. But the problem was that they were not doing comic-book-club activities. They were carrying out terrorist attacks with the goal of killing people.
hunks.sol: Sure, some were probably little groups that operated on the scale of clubs. The problem was, they weren’t meeting to talk about comics. They carried out attacks to kill people.

hunks.sol: The bodies of the people who had died before my eyes only weeks ago came back to me. So did their screams. A weight settled in my chest.

hunks.baseline: His gaze was deeply sunken as he remembered someone who had left his side not long ago.

hunks.sol: “Can I ask you something?”
